scope: Two public discovery searches, one candlestick repository listing and one pinned Pine mirror listing, then inspection of seven strategy files. Prior survey exclusions reused; no search on measured returns or threshold selection.
constraint: Exclude Bollinger entirely and redundant RSI/stochastic/CCI/ADX/Ichimoku/MA/SAR/CMF aliases; require interpretable fixed published entry/exit/protection without silent repairs

inspected_sources.name: Candlestick Pattern Strategy1 / CP1
inspected_sources.source_timeframe: No enforced timeframe; source identifies scalping and1minute example

defaults.long_signal: close>open AND previous_close>previous_open AND previous_open<open AND close>previous_close AND low<previous_low AND low<previous_open
defaults.short_signal: close<open AND previous_close<previous_open AND previous_open>open AND close<previous_close AND high>previous_high AND high>previous_open
defaults.reverse_true: Swap trade direction and stop/target roles

inspected_sources.exclusion: Entry order is submitted and open-trade entry_price read in same calculation before new fill. Flat first entry can produceNaN, existing position can supply stale price. Moving computation after fill or replacing with close is a repaired candidate, not accepted here.
inspected_sources.eight_hour_obstacle: Scalping-to8h adaptation and target/protection lifecycle require changed semantics; no outcomes evaluated
